class Solution:
    def maximumOr(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        prefix = [0] * n
        suffix = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            prefix[i] = nums[i] if i == 0 else prefix[i-1] | nums[i]
        for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            suffix[i] = nums[i] if i == n-1 else suffix[i+1] | nums[i]
        ans = 0
        for i in range(n):
            left = prefix[i-1] if i > 0 else 0
            right = suffix[i+1] if i < n-1 else 0
            rest_or = left | right
            candidate = (nums[i] << k) | rest_or
            if candidate > ans:
                ans = candidate
        return ans

from typing import List

class Solution:
    def maximumOr(self, nums: List[int], k: int) -> int:
        n = len(nums)
        # Prefix ORs
        prefix = [0] * n
        for i in range(n):
            if i == 0:
                prefix[i] = nums[i]
            else:
                prefix[i] = prefix[i-1] | nums[i]
        # Suffix ORs
        suffix = [0] * n
        for i in range(n-1, -1, -1):
            if i == n-1:
                suffix[i] = nums[i]
            else:
                suffix[i] = suffix[i+1] | nums[i]

        ans = 0
        for i in range(n):
            left = prefix[i-1] if i > 0 else 0
            right = suffix[i+1] if i < n-1 else 0
            rest_or = left | right
            # Apply all k multiplications (left shifts) to nums[i]
            candidate = (nums[i] << k) | rest_or
            if candidate > ans:
                ans = candidate
        return ans
